description: Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité (au 31 décembre 2017) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce registre présente les installations de production et de stockage d'électricité raccordées directement ou indirectement aux réseaux publics d’électricité en France métropolitaine et dans les zones non interconnectées (ZNI) au 31 décembre 2017. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Production, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are Stockage, Territoire, IRIS, Région, Parc, HVD. The portal shows 2024-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
